statement: This sketch visualizes market volatility through abstract, dynamic motion. Swirling lines representing market trends move erratically across the canvas, expanding and contracting in rhythm with an underlying pulse. Red and green nodes—symbolizing key market points or assets—scatter throughout the space. When lines pass near these nodes, they trigger expanding rings that dissipate quickly, evoking the rapid, energetic reactions of market activity. The continuous animation without user input captures the restless, fluctuating nature of financial systems, rendering abstract economic forces into a mesmerizing visual symphony of motion and interaction.
